text:
mike: Heads-up — seeing repeated TLS handshake failures edge->eu-proxy since ~08:12 UTC. Clients get 502s, logs show 'certificate verify failed' and 'no shared cipher'. Anyone around?

sec-bot: incident-alert: TLS handshake error rate spike detected in eu region (auto-threshold). Severity: medium.

aruna: Can you paste the openssl/s_client output and the proxy tls config? Also which cert bundle was deployed to eu earlier?

mike: here's the quick s_client output I ran from edge host:
```
openssl s_client -connect eu-proxy.internal:443 -servername service-a
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = service-a
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
verify return:1
---
SSL handshake has read 1534 bytes and written 512 bytes
Verify return code: 21 (unable to verify the first certificate)
```

sara: looks like missing intermediate in the chain or wrong CA. We rotated leaf cert yesterday from internal-CA -> acme-inc; intermediates may not have been pushed to proxies. Also saw KMS decrypt errors in control-plane around 08:10.

jonathan: I see a KMS permission denied for the cert-issuer service account in eu at 08:09:42: `PermissionDenied: cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt`. That coincides with the cert rotation job. Last-night RBAC change removed a broad role; possible least-privilege regression.

ops-jen: I just reverted the RBAC patch (rolled back iam change) 2m ago. Re-triggering cert distribution: `rbt-cert-sync --region eu --force` and tailing the job.

mike: after force-sync, error rate dropped ~80% but still seeing occasional 'no shared cipher' entries — suspect SNI mismatch serving default cert for some backends. Proxy config shows `ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3` and `ssl_ciphers` set to a modern profile.

sara: double-check the SNI map and canary route hostnames — we had a typo in the canary ingress rules earlier (service-a vs svc-a). Also enable handshake-level audit logging on the proxy for 24h: add `handshake.failure=true` to debug flags so we can correlate client IPs and exact failure reasons.

jonathan: filing quick incident note and tagging for follow-up. Action items I have: 1) Confirm KMS perms and restore minimal required role for cert-issuer SA, 2) Verify full cert chain (leaf + intermediates) is present on eu proxies, 3) Reconcile the RBAC change in the infra PR and add a rollback test, 4) Enable handshake audit logs for 24h and ingest to security-log-bucket for analysis.

mike: thanks. Can someone take owner for postmortem + customer comms to partners? @ops-jen

ops-jen: will own postmortem and timeline. I'll attach sync job logs, KMS request traces, and the cert chain from one of the failing proxies and post within 1h. :thumbsup:
